headline.zh-Hant: 港大 · 人工智能與數據科學

tagline.en: I build small, complete tools — and write down what makes them true.
tagline.zh-Hant: 我做小而完整的工具，也把「為甚麼成立」寫清楚。

photoAlt.en: Pixel-art illustration of Harry OneZion at a desk, with the caption “one more leap of faith”.
photoAlt.zh-Hant: Harry OneZion 坐在書桌前的像素插畫，附有「為創造，再一次信仰之躍」的題字。

bio.en: I'm a second-year student at HKU, reading AI & Data Science alongside AI and Humanities. Most of what I build starts at that seam: engineering that has to hold up in front of people, and questions about people that only engineering can answer at scale.
bio.zh-Hant: 我是港大二年級學生，主修人工智能與數據科學，同時修讀人工智能與人文。我大部分作品都從這條接縫開始：一邊是要在人前站得住的工程，另一邊是關於人、只有工程才回答得動的問題。

bio.en: I ship small, complete things rather than demos: a polished site with design styles customized to a HKDSE education company, a menu-bar app that keeps a Mac awake with the lid closed, a communication abstraction proxy MCP that agents go through to manage all platforms and draft messages, with a UI for human approval. Every one of them has a URL or a repository.
bio.zh-Hant: 我交付的是小而完整的東西，不是示範：一個為香港 DSE 教育公司度身設計、有自己設計語言的網站；一個合上蓋仍讓 Mac 保持清醒的選單列工具；一個通訊抽象代理 MCP——所有平台都經它管理、經它起草訊息，再由介面取得人手批准。每一件都有一條網址或一個倉庫。
bio.zh-Hans: 我交付的是小而完整的东西，不是演示：一个为香港 DSE 教育公司量身设计、有自己设计语言的网站；一个合上盖仍让 Mac 保持清醒的菜单栏工具；一个通信抽象代理 MCP——所有平台都经它管理、经它起草消息，再通过界面取得人工批准。每一件都有一个网址或一个仓库。

bio.en: The method repeats. Question the frame before solving inside it, decompose until every piece can be verified, and never call something finished without evidence I can point at.
bio.zh-Hant: 方法每次都一樣。先質疑框架，再在框架內解題；分解到每一塊都可以驗證；沒有指得出的證據，就不說完成。

body.en: A private control plane for personal agents — six layers from input to memory to execution. Local only, reachable over Tailscale, 669 contract tests green as of 2026-11-05.
body.zh-Hant: 個人 Agent 的私有控制面——由輸入、記憶到執行共六層。只在本地運行，經 Tailscale 存取；截至 2026-11-05，669 個契約測試全綠。

body.en: Engineer at a DSE tutoring team: the public site and content system, which the team updates without a developer, plus the DSE Paper 3 Part A production system behind its course products.
body.zh-Hant: DSE 補習團隊的工程師：負責對外網站與內容系統，團隊不用開發者也能自行更新；同時負責課程產品背後的 DSE Paper 3 Part A 生產系統。

body.en: AI & Data Science with AI and Humanities. Coursework stays off this site; the projects here are self-run.
body.zh-Hant: 人工智能與數據科學，配人工智能與人文。課業不放在這個網站；這裏的項目都是自己做的。
